Total emissions of black carbon from the surface to the atmosphere due to any process as seen by the model. A positive value indicates release of to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CH4 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any process. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. This should be the sum of the "Emissions|CH4" and "Natural Fluxes|CH4" quantities.

Total flux of CH4 from the surface due to any process of anthropogenic origin. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.  This should be the sum of the "Emissions|CH4|Biomass Burning", "Emissions|CH4|Fossil and Industry", and "Emissions|CH4|Other" quantities.
Total flux of CH4 from the surface to the atmosphere due to biomass burning. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CH4 from the surface to the atmosphere due to fossil fuel burning, industry, and Agriculture, Forestry and other land use (AFOLU) processes. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CH4 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any process of anthropogenic origin that is not included in "Fossil, Industry and AFOLU" and "Biomass Burning" categories. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CH4 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any natural processes. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.  This should be the sum of the "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Emissions", minus "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Sink" and "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Other"quantities.

Natural emissions of CH4 due to any natural processes. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. This should be the sum of the "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Emissions|Other", "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Emissions|Permafrost" and "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Emissions|Wetland" quantities.

Natural emissions of CH4 due to any processes not included in "Permafrost" and "Wetland" categories. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.
Natural emissions of CH4 due to permafrost thawing. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.
Natural emissions of CH4 associated to wetlands. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.
Natural flux of CH4 not covered in any other natural category. A positive value indicates release of CH4 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

CH4 flux associated with any natural sink. A positive value indicates uptake of CH4 to the sink/CH4 atmospheric loss, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere gain. This should be the sum of the "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Sink|Other", "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Sink|Soil", "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Sink|Stratosphere", and "Natural Fluxes|CH4|Sink|Troposphere" quantities.

CH4 flux associated with any processes not included in "Troposphere", "Stratosphere", and "Soil" categories. A positive value indicates uptake of CH4 to the sink/net atmospheric loss, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere gain.
CH4 flux associated with soil uptake. A positive value indicates uptake of CH4 to the sink, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere gain.
CH4 flux associated with stratosphere oxidation. A positive value indicates CH4 atmospheric loss, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere gain.
CH4 flux associated with troposphere oxidation. A positive value indicates a net CH4 atmospheric loss, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere gain.

Total flux of CO2 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any process. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. This should be the sum of the "Emissions|CO2" and "Natural Fluxes|CO2" quantities.

Total flux of CO2 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any process of anthropogenic origin. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. This should be the sum of the "Emissions|CO2|Fossil and Industry",   "Emissions|CO2|Land Use Change", and   "Emissions|CO2|Other" quantities.

Total flux of CO2 from the surface to the atmosphere due to fossil fuel and industry use. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.
Total flux of CO2 from the surface due to changes in land use and cover. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CO2 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any process of anthropogenic origin that is not included in "Emissions|CO2|Fossil and Industry" and "Emissions|CO2|Land Use Change" categories. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CO2 from the surface to the atmosphere due to any natural processes. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.  This should be the sum of the "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Land", "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Ocean" and ""Natural Fluxes|CO2|Other" quantities.

Total flux of CO2 from land to the atmosphere due to any natural processes. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. Notice that the only component of "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Land" requested to be independetely reported is "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Land|Permafrost", but we make no prescription of how other carbon cycle fluxes should be aggregated to form this quantity.

Total flux of CO2 from land to the atmosphere due to permafrost thawing. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. Notice that this is the only component of "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Land" requested to be independetely reported, but we make no prescription of how other carbon cycle fluxes should be aggregated to form that quantity. Notice as well that this is is a CO2 flux, not a carbon flux, so fluxes of carbon in other chemical configurations (methane) should not be included here.
Total flux of CO2 from ocean to the atmosphere due to any natural processes. A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss.

Total flux of CO2 to the atmosphere due to any natural processes that has not been reported as part of "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Land" and  "Natural Fluxes|CO2|Ocean". A positive value indicates release of CO2 to the atmosphere, and a negative value indicates a net atmosphere loss. Please provide a definition of other sources in this category in the 'comments' tab.
